entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: You're late. What took so long?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Urghhh, that's it! I've had it up to here[n]with her!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The ray of light is even longer now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shoot, this is bad! Get back!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm sick of this bullshit! What the hell[n]is she thinkin'!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uhh, is this what I think...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Back, back! I am not gonna be[n]crushed here!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We can't proceed on like this. We need to[n]do something about that giant boulder.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A stone slab... "When red and blue[n]align, an illusion will rise. Only[n]proper guidance shall form a path."

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? What is it talking about?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I haven't the slightest idea. It may be[n]a hint of some kind.
